svg.title: Profile-first (Option D): the chain from the rule to the claim and the result
svg.desc: A chain of 6 steps, each drawn as one row per relationship, with the field that holds the pointer on the left and the field it resolves to on the right. Step 1, rule to check, is made of 1 relationship. parts[assessment-method].links[rel=assessment-objective].href in the profile, which holds #sc-28_obj-ubtu-24-600090, reference to parts[assessment-objective].id in the profile. Step 2, rule to control, is made of 2 relationships. no field in the profile containment to alters[].control-id in the profile. alters[].control-id in the profile, which holds sc-28, reference to controls[].id in the catalog. Step 3, check to runtime, is made of 2 relationships. parts[assessment-method].props[name=language].value in the profile, which holds bash, no join to no field in the nothing. parts[assessment-method].props[name=evaluation].value in the profile, which holds exit-code, no join to no field in the nothing. Step 4, runtime to claim, is made of 1 relationship. no field in the profile no join to by-components[].description in the system-security-plan. Step 5, runtime to result, is made of 1 relationship. observations[].subjects[].subject-uuid in the assessment-results, which holds 06297a03-cae0-414b-8332-2fc882f81aa1, reference to system-implementation.inventory-items[].uuid in the system-security-plan. Step 6, result to control, is made of 1 relationship. findings[].target.target-id in the assessment-results, which holds sc-28_obj-ubtu-24-600090, reference to alters[].adds[].parts[].id in the profile. Every value is rule 1, data at rest, as the six questions page encodes it for this approach.
